# EnterpriseGlue v0.40.13 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.40.12`.

## Highlights

- **frontend:** Starts engine totals alongside project statistics when opening a verified workspace dashboard.

## User and administrator impact

- Engine totals can appear sooner on reload. Project totals still display as soon as their own request finishes.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Both requests use the verified workspace session and its permission snapshot.
